companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Spanish; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: ¡Hola! A greeting and your name before entry, please. This is a market, not an administrative free-for-all.
lines.translation: Hello! A greeting and your name before entry, please. This is a market, not an administrative free-for-all.
lines.narrative: An archway clears her throat. A visitors’ book protrudes from her keystone, already disappointed by its lack of entries.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Muy bien. Your greeting is approved. ¿Cómo te llamas? The name field remains blank, and blank is not a person. Usually.
lines.translation: Hello! Very good. Your greeting is approved. What is your name? The name field remains blank, and blank is not a person. Usually.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. She ticks one box with the satisfaction of a bureaucracy making limited progress.

lines.native: Muy bien, Sam. Your introduction is approved. One courtesy remains: ¿y mi nombre? I do have one. It is not ‘the entrance.’
lines.translation: Very good, Sam. Your introduction is approved. One courtesy remains: and my name? I do have one. It is not ‘the entrance.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from Portia’s keystone. She records Sam with the solemnity normally reserved for disputed borders.

lines.native: ¡Me llamo Portia! Mucho gusto, Sam. You asked. How perfectly civil. Puedes entrar. Your paperwork is complete; please do not make this weird.
lines.translation: My name is Portia! Nice to meet you, Sam. You asked. How perfectly civil. You may enter. Your paperwork is complete; please do not make this weird.
lines.narrative: The archway blushes faintly pink around the mortar. A visitors’ book snaps shut in her keystone; courtesy has prevailed over structural rigidity.
